lines.text: Good afternoon. How has the jaw been since last time?
The clicking on the right is quieter, and I can fit three fingers in my mouth now.
That's a good gain. Have you kept the gum chewing to a minimum?
Mostly. I still clench when I'm stressed at work, my partner says I grind at night too.
Rest your tongue on the roof of your mouth behind your top teeth, lips together, teeth apart, whenever you notice clenching.
I'd also like you to ask your dentist about a night guard.
Thank you, that concludes today's session. Please book a follow up in four weeks at reception.
Good afternoon. Ms Lindqvist, please do come through and take a seat.
Thank you. I've had pins and needles in both hands for a fortnight, mostly at night.
